_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your Discord webhook URL.
_comment_control: Optional: configure the watcher by typing commands in Discord. Needs a bot token (a webhook cannot receive messages). Leave the token empty to turn this off.
_comment_telegram: Optional: notifications-only delivery via Telegram. One bot serves everyone; each person's chat id goes in subscribers.json. Get a token from @BotFather.
_comment_users: Delete subscribers.json (or never create it) to run single-user off this file plus keywords.txt. See subscribers.example.json for the multi-user format.
_comment_age: Do not notify about listings older than this many hours. Stops an overnight restart replaying stale posts as if they were fresh. 0 turns the cut off; posts whose age cannot be read are never cut.
